title: Bag of bricks- Cream 20
descriptionHtml:
Cream — colour 20

A soft off-white that lifts highlights without the glare of pure white. Cream is the kinder option for portraits and pastel work, where White 37 can read as a hard edge.

Works well with: White 37, Beige 09, Light Nougat 02

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Cream bricks (colour 20) for Memobrick mosaics. A soft off-white that lifts highlights without the harshness of pure white.
